resources.string: Optional plugins start disabled. The required compatibility plugin stays enabled. Feature switches affect screens and new downloads; existing tasks and files are preserved.
Analyze Instagram and TikTok images, videos and multi-page posts. When disabled, use the original video engine.
Load and select posts and reels from an Instagram profile. Works independently of the social plugin.
Saved-file reuse, AV1 conversion and container settings. Folder classification is configured in Media folders and file manager.
Image/video folders, individual resolution tiers, history filters, grouped posts and file management. Works without video encoding.
Grouped posts, detailed information, multi-selection, deletion and an internal viewer. When disabled, use the original queue.
Show URL input and settings together, with menu favorites and a quick cookie profile. When disabled, use the original two-step input.
Enable the social download plugin and try again.
Enable social downloads in plugin management to download Instagram accounts or image lists.
Choose a profile registered in network settings. Selecting a profile does not enable cookie transmission.
Always enabled (required). Preserves existing tasks, history and storage safety. This plugin cannot be disabled.
Enable the Instagram profile download plugin and try again.
Disabled resolution tiers stay in the base image or video folder. Lower tiers are not substituted.
View frequent Instagram accounts and browse posts or profiles.
Display author avatar, username, caption, and hashtags in queue and list.
Loop the selected video without sound.
Choose where to apply the video on the next screen.
Separate downloads and history inside tmp. Internal storage folders only.
Temporary files and history will be deleted. Merge them into your normal library first?
